articles.title: World Cup final half-time to last up to 25 minutes
articles.summary: The half-time break in Sunday's World Cup final is expected to last between 20 and 25 minutes.

articles.title: Spain into World Cup final after victory over France
articles.summary: Spain are into the 2026 World Cup final after goals from Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro see them convincingly beat France 2-0 in their semi-final in Dallas.

articles.title: Balogun expected controversy after World Cup ban waived
articles.summary: United States striker Folarin Balogun knew the decision by Fifa to suspend his one-game ban at the World Cup was going to bring "a lot of controversy" and said it brought "nerves" on his team-mates.

articles.title: Montrose stun Dundee Utd as Ayr shock Falkirk in League Cup groups
articles.summary: Dundee United and fellow Premiership side Falkirk’s hopes of progressing from the Scottish League Cup group stage are in the balance after they were beaten by lower-league opponents.

articles.title: Barry's journey from Accrington Stanley to World Cup semi-final
articles.summary: His playing career peaked at Accrington Stanley - now Anthony Barry is Thomas Tuchel's right-hand man in England's bid for World Cup glory.
